title: Flatworld+ Updated
description: A Challenging Superflat Survival with Shaders, Redstone contraptions, and a whole lot of Building Blocks
body:
# **What is this pack?**

Flatworld+ Updated is finally here, a new modpack where you start in a superflat world, with nothing but slimes, grass, and structures to loot! It's now time to create your forever flatworld!

## **Features**

- Almost all of the vanilla structures are here!
- Survival tools that will help you a lot: Hammer, Excavators, and new beacon effects.
- A lot of different dishes to cook.
- Villagers will now trade you more interesting things! New Villager Types!


### **How to start?**

Select "World Type: Superflat" and create your world. Your first mission is to find a village. Kill some slimes to get slimeballs and craft a Slime Hammer and armor for some early-game protection.


Q: How do I get building blocks?

A: This modpack offers many of them, obtainable from villager trading (like most of the resources) and chiseling.

#

Flatworld is a reboot of "[The Enhanced Superflat Experience](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/the-modded-superflat-experience)", now discontinued.
